negative_reviews.author: tracyx11 n
negative_reviews.text: The egg was simultaneously over cooked and jammy. They obviously didn't make it fresh. The ramen was nice. Service was very friendly and polite but they forgot to give us water even though we ordered it along with another drink (that was served) so I had to ask again. A couple of tables ordered after us and got their food (also ramen) before us which I was disappointed in because I was starving at that point. Overall pleasant experience but just could have been better.

negative_reviews.author: Louisa
negative_reviews.text: Had the vegan ramen. Soup too salty, noodles ok, the vegan meat the texture of cardboard. Would not recommend vegan ramen. Restaurant had loud music - difficult to chat. Staff was friendly!
